name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Barishal Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)
organization: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the Rajshahi, Rangpur, Dhaka, Chattogram and Khulna runs (no text layer). Barishal Division's offices are in the booklet's 'খুলনা রিজিয়ন ৭০০০-৯৯৯৯': p. 25 (PDF page 14, right half, from 'বরিশাল জেলা ৮২০০-৮২৯৯': Barishal, Bhola and the Jhalokathi head-office group; the Gopalganj section above it is left out) and p. 26 (PDF page 15, left half: the rest of Jhalokathi, Pirojpur, Patuakhali and Barguna, up to 'খুলনা জি, পি, ও ৯০০০'); only these were transcribed, by hand, from the page images (raw/*.png, PDF pages 14 and 15 rotated; the same files as in the Khulna folder). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Two office names are uncertain readings, one code is printed twice and two codes are printed outside their district range (flagged). The Banaripara group (8530-8531) is printed under Pirojpur and is placed in Barishal District (flagged). Branch post offices are not in the booklet. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
